analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 67.0 entering overbought territory, MACD histogram continues to improve. RSI rose from 50.4 five days ago to the current 67.0, confirming exit from oversold and strengthening the uptrend. The current price of $2,659.63 forms a Higher Low pattern relative to the 5-day low of $2,368.74. Price remains above SMA5 ($2,553.23), SMA20 ($2,492.3), and SMA50 ($2,273.76), maintaining bullish alignment.
